entities.name: Abu-Bakr Yunis Jabr

entities.summary: Abu-Bakr Yunis Jabr was a Libyan military officer and politician who was the Minister of Defence of Libya during the rule of Muammar Gaddafi. His official position was Secretary of the Libyan General Committee for Defence.
